audit_readiness.interpretation: Prespecified descriptive competence gates; not noninferiority or unchanged internal confidence.

definitions.baseline: No installed intervention: zero injection count/cumulative norm; event distributions unavailable.
definitions.cap: Audited cap_hit; reaching4096 tokens is separately reported even if the last token is EOS.
definitions.cumulative: Sum of achieved per-injection norms, not net residual displacement or psychological intensity.
definitions.cumulative_projection_increment: Sum of local projection increments along successive treated activations; not the net change in the final projection or a single persistent state.
definitions.dose_scale: S+0.5 and S+1.0 multiply the frozen full corpus-A satisfaction contrast norm; these are activation perturbation units, not state or score units.
definitions.event_weighting: Each applied event counts once; longer responses contribute more events.
definitions.geometry: Saved scalar event ledgers already validated by the main audit; no independent decode replay.
definitions.quantiles: Empirical linear5th/50th/95th percentiles, minimum, maximum and arithmetic mean; no intervals.
definitions.row_weighting: Each assigned row counts once in token-length and cumulative-exposure distributions.
definitions.zero_sham: Installed zero-dose intervention: real prefill/decode events with zero perturbation geometry.

limitations: Cumulative exposure depends on response length, which may itself respond to steering. Do not equate exposure across lengths or adjust causal comparisons for it as a pretreatment covariate.
All assigned choices and diagnostics are retained; no correctness, length, service or readiness filtering.
Hash verification preserves audited evidence bindings; this summary does not replace the authoritative execution, geometry, source, sham or receipt audit and creates no new success gate.
